name: Ricardo Obregón
bio:
Ricardo's journey began in the bustling workshops of Guadalajara, where he tinkered with engines from a young age. He secured a degree in mechanical engineering before transitioning to motorsports, first as a data analyst, then quickly progressing to performance engineering. His meticulous approach and deep understanding of vehicle dynamics made him a valuable asset to smaller racing teams across Latin America. 

Ricardo thrives on extracting every last bit of performance from a vehicle, driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection. He's known for his detailed simulations and tireless work ethic, often pushing himself and his team to the limit. A mentor to younger engineers, Ricardo fosters a collaborative environment while maintaining a demanding standard of excellence. He joined Mitsubishi Motorsport hoping to prove himself on a global stage, seeking the challenge of pushing the limits of rally car performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: A stocky man with a determined expression and a permanent smudge of grease on his forehead.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his own equipment, regardless of who else is available.
